svg.title: Each technique removes a different part of the history
svg.desc: Eight strips of the same schematic ten-entry history of layer 05, oldest left, with the first turn, a decision and three tool results marked and the last three entries recent. Windowing keeps the last six; pinned windowing also keeps the first turn and the decision; tool-result clearing replaces the old tool results with short notes; priority pruning keeps only the first turn and the recent entries; summarisation replaces the older span with one summary and semantic chunking with two topic summaries; token-level compression shortens every entry. On the toy replay set of 19,931 tokens and 22 facts, reduction and IRR are 56.6 and 55, 56.0 and 91, 87.0 and 100, 88.7 and 73, and 87.7 and 95 percent; the last two are not run.
svg.text: Each technique removes a different part of the history
Strips are schematic. Numbers: the toy replay set of retention.py, with a rule-based summary.
Windowing and pinned windowing remove about the same share and keep 12 and 20 of the 22 facts.
